_comment: Tier-2: pitfall (kratos.pfem_solid #0) says the catalog template is an availability-probe STUB and gives as its Signal 'the emitted script is < 30 lines, contains no Model.CreateModelPart() ... results_summary.json has a single note key'. THAT SIGNAL IS NOW UNREACHABLE: a 2026-06-26 honesty audit removed every availability-probe generator, so no script is emitted for this physics at all. Executed on Kratos 10.4.3 (pip wheels, glibc-2.31 host, fresh venv on external ext4 image). Measured: 'pfem_solid' is still a KNOWLEDGE key while GENERATORS holds no entry starting 'pfem_solid_', so generate_input raises ValueError 'No Kratos template for pfem_solid_<variant>' rather than emitting a stub. The fixture pins the corrected state and goes red if a stub generator is ever reintroduced. The fixture imports KratosMultiphysics at module scope; with Kratos absent the import raises, the process exits non-zero and the runner records a failure, never a pass.
